purpose: Latest acquisition priority after OpenMMS, cooling-circuit, part-traceability and wave-7 review.

priorityQueue.gap: Authorised real-site shot-linked validation with intervention and verified recovery
priorityQueue.why: Public research now covers many mechanisms, but MouldMaster still lacks its own authorised plant evidence linking a shot to machine, mould, cavity, exact material, actual signals, defect, diagnosis, intervention and recovery.
True item difficulty, discrimination, confidence calibration and learning gain remain impossible to estimate from external proxy datasets.

priorityQueue.currentState: 20 blinded case packets; 0 completed independent MouldMaster engineer labels
priorityQueue.why: This remains the key human-comparison validation requirement.

priorityQueue.gap: Rights-clear multi-machine / multi-mould industrial anomaly and quality data
priorityQueue.why: Independent-machine transfer and rare-fault generalisation remain weak despite strong single-family public datasets.

priorityQueue.gap: Finish admission review of the OpenMMS raw fault-transition family
priorityQueue.why: This is the strongest new directly accessible raw family: pinned 2.87 MB CSV, 110 reported cycles, 54 initial normal cycles, pressure/temperature/ejection-force/inertial sensing and a controlled extraction fault.

priorityQueue.gap: Extract and profile the LEGO six-machine-family energy appendix
priorityQueue.why: 275 industrial steady-state measurements across six machine families offer unusually valuable independent energy calibration.

priorityQueue.gap: Recover and profile the RWTH PCR archive
priorityQueue.why: The authoritative record exposes the raw archive and the experiment contains cavity pressure, screw-antechamber pressure, control output, screw motion and part mass across virgin/recycled material transitions, but binary retrieval remains blocked in the current runtime.

priorityQueue.gap: Natural machine/mould component wear and maintenance lifecycle
priorityQueue.why: OpenMMS now gives controlled normal→fault ejection evidence, but it is a deliberately simulated fault. MouldMaster still needs naturally accumulated wear/fouling/failure, repair/replacement and verified post-maintenance recovery.

priorityQueue.gap: Rights-clear cooling-circuit raw histories with fouling/cleaning intervention
priorityQueue.why: Independent measured evidence now covers coolant actuals, 86-mould plant energy/quality and contamination pressure-drop physics; what remains missing is raw longitudinal deterioration and verified cleaning/recovery.
Displayed zone/setpoint information remains better represented than actual manifold/nozzle/valve state tied to cavity-specific quality.
Nine exact-grade manufacturer source candidates now exist, but validated material-grade-v2 promotion still requires immutable source revision/retrieval/fingerprint and test-context mapping.

Article evidence is now strong across gate freeze, micro moulding, dimensional quality, traceability and assisted moulding; raw repeated-cycle releases would mainly improve trace-based assessment and benchmark breadth.
